what: Clock where letters turn instead of hands — the letters ‹12 sec› ‹20 min› ‹15 hr› sit on a circle of radius .36 of the dial diameter, at each hand tip position, following the hand angle (12 o’clock = 0°) turns by that much and reads along the radial direction. The seconds digit jumps one notch every second, a UTC +1 pill sits in the center, and there are 12 ticks of 10px inside the edge. Placed beside the office · city intro, showing that city’s current time

options.offset: Hours offset from UTC (number), default the viewer’s time zone — original City A·City B 1 · City C 0 · City D -8
options.radius: Radius of the circle where needle letters stand (share of the panel’s short side), default .36
options.gap: Share by which the second hand spreads outward and the hour hand inward, default 0 (the three form one circle)
options.words: Words after seconds, minutes, hours (three, comma-separated), default ”seconds, minutes, hours” — original ”secondes, minutes, heures”
options.smooth: when on, the seconds digits glide through milliseconds every frame, default ticks once per second
options.[data-fx-part=sec|min|hour]: Needle letters (children) — missing ones are skipped
options.[data-fx-part=zone]: Center pill (optional), text is written by the user like ‹UTC +1›

use: UTC +1

from.where: index.html city drawer .b-city__clock. Original Framer code part Analog orbit clock (182px · radius .36 · orbitGap 0 · 12 ticks 10px #ccc · smoothSeconds off · runs only within 200px above and below the screen)
